Elegant walnut briar wood pen and pencil set, perfect for anyone who loves classic, refined writing tools. This Limited Edition briar wood pen and pencil set features warm walnut barrels paired with rich gold-tone accents, giving it a timeless, upscale look that stands out on any desk. Guitar (Nishi Works, Ltd.)
Opaque Water Colour Paint Set 18 CS
Opaque Watercolor (Gouache) in Metal Tubes
11" x 4" x 1"
Original Set in Tin
This vintage professional-grade paint set was manufactured in Japan by Nishi Works, Ltd. under the "Guitar" brand name. Featuring a sophisticated mid-century graphic aesthetic, the set contains 18 tubes of opaque water color, a medium often referred to as gouache, known for its flat, matte finish and high pigment density. The yellow enameled metal tin serves as both a storage case and a mixing palette, featuring ten integrated rectangular wells in the lid for color blending.
Set includes 18 individual metal paint tubes with original grey screw caps
Features colors such as Vandyke Brown (208), Burnt Sienna (207), and Chrome Green Light (215)
Original enameled metal tin with iconic Guitar logo and "Made in Japan" markings
Formulas labeled as lead-free and non-poisonous as per original vintage packaging
Condition:
Vintage condition with age-appropriate wear. The exterior of the yellow tin shows visible scuffing, surface scratches, and minor areas of oxidation. The interior cardboard organizer shows light staining from paint contact.
